title: Abakuumi b'Olusuku
intro: Mu lusuku olujjudde ebimera, ekitundu ekimu kyakola obweyamo obw’amaanyi. Naye obumalirivu bwabwe bwagezesebwa ng’okwagala okw’obwakatonda kuyingidde mu nsonga, ne kifuula obugabi bwabwe ensi etaliimu bimera.
clues: Twaweebwa omukisa n’olusuku olujjudde, naye ne tufuuka ab’amalala.
Twakola enteekateeka y’okukungula nga tetugabana na baavu.
Twasitula ku makya ennyo, nga tuli bakakafu mu nteekateeka yaffe.
Naye bwe twatuuka, twasanga olusuku lwaffe nga lusaanyiziddwaawo mu kiro kimu.
Twategeera ensobi yaffe ne tutandika okunenya munne.
Twatuuka ekiseera ne twenenya, naye essomo lyatuyiga kikeerezi nnyo.

outcome.answer: Beenenya naye ne bafiirwa olusuku lwabwe

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
